steps: Open Chase's official business cards page https://creditcards.chase.com/business-credit-cards and confirm the Ink Business Cash $750-after-$6,000 offer is still showing.
Complete the business application (sole proprietorships are eligible); Chase runs a hard inquiry on your personal credit when you apply.
If approved, spend $6,000 on business purchases you were already planning within the first 3 months.
Pay the balance in full — after the 12-month 0% intro, the variable APR (16.74%–24.74%) destroys the bonus.
Redeem the $750 as cash back through Chase Ultimate Rewards.
timing: Application takes 20–40 min active; then route $6,000 in already-planned business spend through the card within 3 months; $750 cash back is redeemable after the threshold.
